windows_full_run.root_cause: Task 2 (1c6d6ba) made optimus_gateway.responses._gateway_usage read config.model_policy. This Plan 12.5 test builds its replies through that function with a config double that had only a provider, so every test using usage_for raised AttributeError. The real config (GatewayServiceConfig) always has the field, defaulting to None, so production is not affected. tools/plan12_memory/harness.py reads usage fields by name and is not affected by the added price_snapshot_id.
